UI FANOUT PASS 3 — COMBAT READABILITY / FEEDBACK. Audit the Onslaught source reconstruction as a combat-UX designer. Improve the interface feedback that helps the player understand danger, weapon state, wave/score progression, interaction prompts, and transitions such as start, active combat, death, restart, or game over. Make the UI feel more game-like and polished while staying restrained and fitting a dark survival zombie shooter. Prioritize glanceable information, feedback timing, consistency, and keeping the center of the screen clear. Do not add new gameplay systems or alter balance. Avoid heavy animation, expensive effects, or noisy overlays. Ensure the design works on desktop and mobile landscape. Return a coherent unified diff within the allowlisted source-reconstruction scope, plus exact tests the lead should run. Do not claim tests were run.
